name: scan-to-data
title: ScanToData
description: Camera or photo becomes structured data (receipt, business card, event, or your own schema) via on-device OCR and the local model.

files.content:
import { z } from 'zod'

export const receiptSchema = z.object({
  merchant: z.string(),
  total: z.number(),
  currency: z.string().optional(),
  date: z.string().describe('date').optional(),
  category: z.enum(['food', 'groceries', 'transport', 'shopping', 'health', 'other']).optional(),
  paymentMethod: z.enum(['card', 'cash', 'other']).optional(),
})

export const businessCardSchema = z.object({
  name: z.string(),
  company: z.string().optional(),
  title: z.string().optional(),
  email: z.string().optional(),
  phone: z.string().optional(),
  website: z.string().optional(),
})

export const eventSchema = z.object({
  title: z.string(),
  date: z.string().describe('date').optional(),
  time: z.string().optional(),
  location: z.string().optional(),
  notes: z.string().optional(),
})

export const presets = { receipt: receiptSchema, businessCard: businessCardSchema, event: eventSchema } as const
export type ScanPreset = keyof typeof presets | 'custom'

export { ScanToData, type ScanToDataProps } from './scan-to-data'
export { useScanToData, type ScanImage, type ScanToDataState, type UseScanToDataOptions } from './use-scan-to-data'
export { presets, receiptSchema, businessCardSchema, eventSchema, type ScanPreset } from './schema'
export { scanInstructions } from './prompts'

docs: Pass `ocr` (e.g. @react-native-ml-kit/text-recognition or Apple Vision) to read photos; without it the component explains that OCR is not configured.

budget.strategy: OCR text (not the image) goes to the model; fields refined deterministically.
